description: This file defines a virtual class for CKEDITOR command definitions, serving as documentation and illustrative purposes rather than actual executable code. It explains the structure and properties of command definition objects used within the CKEditor plugin framework.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.commandDefinition
classes.description: Virtual class that describes the structure and properties of command objects used in CKEditor, including methods like 'exec' and properties like 'canUndo', 'async', etc.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.commandDefinition.prototype.exec
methods.description: Method to execute the command within a given editor instance, optionally accepting additional data, returning a boolean indicating success.
